title: Governance Delivery Observation
description: A buyer-attributed delivery observation kept as audit evidence. It never overwrites the seller's delivery statement.

observation_id.description: Stable buyer-issued identifier for this observation.

source.description: Whether the buyer is forwarding the seller statement it received or reporting an independently measured observation. A forwarded seller statement is not independent evidence.

seller_statement_id.description: Seller statement identifier as received by the buyer. Required for seller_statement_copy.

seller_statement_digest.description: Digest received with the seller statement. Governance compares it to the seller-authenticated canonical digest.

reporting_period.description: Start and end timestamps for the reporting window.

cumulative_spend.description: Buyer-attributed cumulative spend for the governed action.

period_closed.description: Buyer-declared operational closure of this governance reporting period. When true, governance freezes the period after recording this observation. An unresolved mismatch becomes closed_unresolved and no longer blocks later governance. Closure is not final billing or commercial settlement. Only the authenticated plan owner may set this to true; the governance agent MUST reject it from any other authenticated reporter.
